cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 61% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.56% · WTI -0.81% · Brent -1.64% · NatGas +0.60%. 61% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +6.76%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Shale & E&P lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +6.76%; weakest is Shale & E&P at -0.86%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: ARRY is the standout at +10.92%
cards.body: Leaders: ARRY +10.92%, BE +10.14%, TLN +9.20%, ENPH +8.16%, ETN +7.10%. Laggards: MPC -2.80%, MPLX -2.54%, FANG -2.04%, APA -1.74%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
